title: 우편환법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Types of Postal Money Transfers) The types and conditions for postal money transfers as defined in Article 4 of the "Postal Money Transfer Act" (hereinafter referred to as "the Act") are as follows: <Amended July 31, 1998, April 30, 2007, July 8, 2016>
1. Standard Postal Money Transfer: The sender submits a money transfer request form along with cash to the post office, and the post office, upon receiving it, issues a standard postal money transfer certificate and receipt to the sender. The post office then requests payment of the standard postal money transfer from the recipient and the person who has acquired the right to receive the postal money transfer in accordance with Article 13(1) of the Act, and exchanges the standard postal money transfer certificate for payment.
2. Online Postal Money Transfer: The sender submits a money transfer request form along with cash to the post office, and the post office, upon receiving it, issues an online postal money transfer receipt to the sender. The post office also notifies the post office that issues and sends an online postal money transfer certificate, and the post office that receives the notification issues and sends the online postal money transfer certificate to the recipient. The post office then requests payment of the online postal money transfer from the recipient.

1. The postal service processes online currency exchange by exchanging online currency certificates.
